title: "Chapter 3 - MacroMicro - MCA - Within Tool Class - NAs Removed"
output: word_document
date: "2026-07-15"
---

```{r}
# Load packages
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)

#Load dataset
macro_micro_na_removed <- read.csv("Macro and Micro Data - Removed NAs.csv")

```

## R Markdown
```{r}
# Subset to Axe 1 and Axe 2 only
Axe_data <- macro_micro_na_removed[
  macro_micro_na_removed$Tool %in% c("Axe 1", "Axe 2"), 
]

# Select active macro/micro variables
Axe_active_vars <- Axe_data[, c(
  "Macro_Kerf_Transection",
  "Macro_Edge_1_Regularity",
  "Macro_Edge_2_Regularity",
  "Macro_Wall_1_Regularity",
  "Macro_Wall_2_Regularity",
  "Macro_Floor_Regularity",
  "Macro_Edge_1_Chattering",
  "Macro_Edge_2_Chattering",
  "Macro_Edge_1_Feathering",
  "Macro_Edge_2_Feathering",
  "Macro_Edge_1_Flaking",
  "Macro_Edge_2_Flaking",
  "Macro_Edge_1_Fracturing",
  "Macro_Edge_2_Fracturing",
  "Macro_Edge_1_Peeling",
  "Macro_Edge_2_Peeling",
  "Micro_Kerf_Floor_Regularity",
  "Micro_Edge_1_Regularity",
  "Micro_Edge_2_Regularity",
  "Micro_Wall_1_Regularity",
  "Micro_Wall_2_Regularity",
  "Micro_Edge_1_Microscopic_Fracturing",
  "Micro_Edge_2_Microscopic_Fracturing",
  "Micro_Edge_1_Fossae",
  "Micro_Edge_2_Fossae",
  "Micro_Edge_1_Uprising",
  "Micro_Edge_2_Uprising",
  "Micro_Wall_1_Flaking",
  "Micro_Wall_2_Flaking",
  "Micro_Wall_1_Striations",
  "Micro_Wall_2_Striations"
)]

# Convert to factors
Axe_active_vars[] <- lapply(Axe_active_vars, as.factor)

# Run MCA
mca_Axe <- MCA(Axe_active_vars, graph = FALSE)

# View eigenvalues
eig_values_na_removed <- get_eigenvalue(mca_Axe)
print(eig_values_na_removed)

# Plot individuals colored by tool
fviz_mca_ind(
  mca_Axe,
  label = "none",
  habillage = Axe_data$Tool,
  addEllipses = TRUE,
  ellipse.type = "confidence",
  repel = TRUE
)
```
